Project Manager (m/f/d) – Trade Marketing | Paris

Organization. Communication. Responsibility. Your Project.

Headquartered in Bad Homburg, Germany, JET Services has been one of the leading trade marketing agencies in Europe since 1993. We connect manufacturers, retailers and consumers and develop tailor-made sales and marketing solutions for internationally successful brands.
Our clients include well-known companies from the IT, telecommunications and consumer electronics sectors. For exciting international client projects, we are looking for people who enjoy coordinating, taking responsibility and getting things moving.
To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Project Manager (m/f/d) – Trade Marketing | Paris.
This position is fully remote. You are based in Paris and work 100% from your home office. As part of an international project team, you will work closely with colleagues and clients across different countries.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Coordination:
You coordinate merchandising activities across multiple client projects and ensure that all tasks, deadlines and milestones are delivered reliably and on time.
Communication:
You are a key point of contact for our merchandisers and coordinate communication between the field team, clients and internal project teams. You keep track of requests, feedback and outstanding topics and ensure consistent follow-up through to completion.

Information:

Onboarding:
You support new team members as they join their respective client projects and ensure a structured and professional onboarding process.

You support the preparation of project data, status overviews and reports, providing transparency across the different client projects.
Materials and Logistics:
You coordinate the provision and distribution of merchandising materials, ensuring that all required materials are available at the right place and at the right time.
Briefing:
You create clear and easy-to-understand briefings for our teams and support their implementation within the respective client projects.
Organization:
You support the project teams with administrative and organizational tasks and ensure that everything runs smoothly, even when several projects are running in parallel.

YOUR PROFILE

Background:
You have completed a commercial/business-related vocational training or hold a degree with a focus on business, management or a related field.
Experience:
You have initial professional experience in project management, sales support, sales operations, merchandising, field force management or a comparable coordination role.
Organization:
You are highly organized, work in a structured manner and are able to keep track of multiple client projects and parallel tasks.
Communication:
You communicate confidently and professionally with a wide range of stakeholders and enjoy bringing people, clients and processes together.
Language French:
You are fluent in French
and are able to communicate confidently and professionally in French.
Language English:
You have very good to fluent English skills
, both written and spoken, and feel comfortable working in an international environment.
Location:
You live in or near Paris and are comfortable working with international teams and clients.
Excel Power:
You have a confident command of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
Service Mindset:
You are reliable, solution-oriented and service-minded, always keeping the needs of your stakeholders in mind.
Hands-on:
You don’t wait for someone else to find a solution. You take initiative, get involved and actively drive topics forward.

WHAT WE OFFER

100% Remote
– You work fully remotely from your home office in or near Paris. No daily commute to the office – just maximum flexibility in where you work.
International Environment
– You work in an international environment with colleagues and clients from different countries and cultures.
Security
– You will receive a permanent position and the security of working for an established and successful company.
Onboarding
– We take the time to support you: comprehensive onboarding and ongoing professional support will help you get off to a confident start in your new role – even when working remotely.
Ownership
– You will work independently and take real ownership of your responsibilities, with genuine opportunities to shape your role and develop professionally.
Career Development
– Looking for your next step? Internal development opportunities offer you perspectives for your future career.
Consumer Electronics
– You will work on exciting projects for internationally successful brands in the consumer electronics sector.
Team Spirit
– Even though you work remotely, you are an integral part of the team. Regular virtual exchanges and team activities ensure strong communication, collaboration and team spirit.
Benefits
– Enjoy attractive employee benefits and additional perks.

READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

Do you love turning a multitude of individual tasks into a perfectly organized project? Do you enjoy communicating, taking responsibility and coordinating international merchandising projects for exciting consumer electronics brands?
Are you fluent in French and English
, based in France
, and able to keep track of multiple client projects running in parallel?

Previous travel industry experience

Ability to facilitate and resolve risks, issues, and showstoppers

jobs.description:
Caption, socialinių tinklų agentūra, ieško Social Media Project Manager 🚀
Atstovausi agentūrą klientui ir klientą agentūrai. Dėl to reiks gerai išklausyti ir dar geriau perduoti informaciją kūrybos komandai. Dirbsi ties kasdiene komunikacija, kampanijomis, darbdavio įvaizdžiu ir strategijų rengimu klientų Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok ir kituose soc. tinkluose (kartais gal net ir ne tik digital medijose). Tau seksis geriausiai, jei nestokoji motyvacijos padėti, viršyti lūkesčius ir rūpintis kliento sėkme.

Tavo pagrindinės atsakomybės bus:
👉 Išsiaiškinti kliento tikslus, suprasti poreikius ir lūkesčius bei juos teisingai išpildyti.
👉 Žinoti kada pasakyti “ne”, o kada pasiūlyti daugiau. Sau, komandai ar klientui.
👉 Valdyti komunikaciją tarp visų projekto pusių (mūsų, kliento, trečiųjų šalių).
👉 Aiškiai deleguoti užduotis komandai ir jų atlikimui planuoti savo bei kolegų laiką – kūrybininkų, dizainerių ir asistentų.
👉 Ieškoti galimybių proaktyviai siūlyti klientams komunikacijos patobulinimus ir naujas kampanijas.

Ko iš tavęs tikimės:
✅ turi bent 2 metų social media projektų valdymo patirties agentūroje, kur buvo būtina greitai reaguoti į besikeičiančias aplinkybes ir valdyti įvairius klientų poreikius;
✅ supranti kaip veikia socialiniai tinklai, seki trendus ir gebi klientui argumentuoti kas yra (ar nėra) platform native turinys.
✅ Matai sąmatą ir supranti, kas ir klientui efektyviausia, ir agentūrai uždirba pinigus;
✅ Gebi dėliotis prioritetus ir sekti kelių projektų deadlainus vienu metu. Puikiai jautiesi dirbant su keliais klientais, sprendžiant keletą iššūkių ir vadovaujant keliems projektams vienu metu.
✅ Esi žmonių žmogus – moki bendrauti ir atrasti bendrą kalbą su visais. Megzti kontaktą su bet kuo.
✅ Nestokoji sąmoningumo, empatijos ir meilės žmonėms. Tikimės, kad klientų sėkmė tau rūpės taip pat, kaip ir tavo kolegų gerovė.

Mes siūlome:
⭐ Pilną etatą su darbo sutartimi (dalis laiko nuotoliniu, dalis ofise (3/2), kaip tau patogu);
⭐ nuo 1400€ atlyginimą „į rankas”;
⭐ Ofisą Vilniaus centre, į kurį gali atsivesti gyvūnų (net pageidautina);
⭐ Darbo įrangą (t.y. kompas, lol);
⭐ Sveikatos paslaugų (sporto klubai, treniruotės, masažai, psichologai, gydytojai) kompensavimą;
⭐ Papildomus laisvadienius už išdirbtą laiką bei trumpesnius penktadienius, visuomet;
⭐ Įmonės keliones, workation’us, užkandžius ofise ir panašias gėrybes;
⭐ Struktūrizuotą darbo aplinką, palaikančius kolegas ir vadovus, darbo laiką be viršvalandžių ir galimybę ramiai atostogauti be kompiuterio rankose.

Caption vertybės:
🚀 Empatija. Klausome ir bandome suprasti. Rūpinamės savo, savo kolegų, ir savo klientų gerove. Būtent tokia seka;
🚀 Ambicija. Taikomės aukštai;
🚀 Pagarba. Bendraujam, dirbam, komunikuojam su pagarba sau, kolegoms, klientams, ir klientų klientams.
Mūsų vaibą dar neužėjusi (-ęs) į ofisą gali pajausti iš mūsų TikTok ir Instagram paskyrų.
Parašyki PVatranka@caption.lt su savo CV ar LinkedIn’o paskyra, patirties aprašymu, antraštėje paminint „Project Manager”. Nepatingėki prisistatyti, tikrai paskaitysim. Savaime suprantama – konfidencialumą garantuojame. Žmogaus ieškome kad ir nuo rytojaus!

Our Purpose

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

Have many careers in one Firm.
Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

--

What will your typical day look like?

As a Senior Manager within Deloitte's SAP Project Management practice, you will:

Lead the delivery of large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation programs, coordinating multiple workstreams, delivery teams, and client stakeholders to achieve successful business outcomes.
Provide leadership and oversight across program governance, planning, execution, risk management, issue resolution, financial management, quality assurance, testing, deployment, and business readiness activities.
Act as a trusted advisor to client executives and program leadership, helping navigate complex delivery challenges, drive key decisions, and maintain alignment between business objectives and implementation priorities.
Oversee PMO, workstream leads, and cross-functional teams, ensuring integrated planning, dependency management, and effective execution across the program.
Drive program performance through proactive identification and mitigation of risks, management of critical issues, and implementation of corrective actions to maintain delivery commitments.
Support executive-level governance forums, steering committee meetings, status reporting, and stakeholder communications for complex transformation initiatives.
Support/Lead SAP S/4HANA sales pursuits by contributing delivery strategy, implementation approaches, governance models, staffing plans, estimates, and client presentations.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of Deloitte's SAP delivery methodologies, program management tools, accelerators, and best practices.
Promote collaboration and knowledge sharing across Deloitte's SAP practice, helping teams leverage lessons learned and leading practices from prior engagements.
Coach and mentor project managers and emerging delivery leaders, supporting their professional development and strengthening Deloitte's project management capabilities.
Support practice growth initiatives, including recruitment, talent development, performance management, training, and certification programs.
Build and maintain strong client relationships that create opportunities for additional services and long-term partnership.

About The Team

The Deloitte SAP practice offers a truly distinctive talent experience that allows our people to do meaningful work; we also offer them opportunities for growth, learning, and leadership wherever they are in their careers.

Our SAP team is deeply experienced in the full range of business and technological challenges; from complex transformations, to mid-market projects, to exponential technologies such as AI and IoT. We recognize that the technology landscape is rapidly changing; our SAP practice stays ahead by embracing innovation and industry leading solutions to transform businesses.

Enough About Us, Let’s Talk About You

You are someone with:

10+ years of overall combined SAP and project/program management experience is required.
An SAP Activate Certification, PMP or other professional project management accreditation
S/4HANA implementation experience required, including agile, multiple end-to-end implementations and experience leading complex, multi-workstream transformation programs.
Experience leading medium to large consulting teams and overseeing project managers, PMO functions, and cross-functional delivery, technical and data workstreams.
Strong knowledge of SAP across both functional and technology components, as well as the governance and delivery processes required for large transformation programs.
Demonstrated experience engaging senior and executive-level client stakeholders and leading program governance and steering committee forums.
Strong risk management, issue management, and engagement financial management experience across large-scale transformation programs.
Strong commitment to professional client service excellence.
Excellent interpersonal relations and demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior client stakeholders, delivery teams, and executive leadership.
Superior verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to develop and present new ideas, lead complex problem solving efforts, and drive successful outcomes in challenging delivery environments.
Canadian travel required, occasional international travel.

The salary range for this position is $105,000 - $234,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.

Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.

Our promise to our people: Deloitte is where potential comes to life.

Be yourself, and more.

We are a group of talented people who want to learn, gain experience, and develop skills. Wherever you are in your career, we want you to advance.

You Shape How We Make Impact.

Diverse perspectives and life experiences make us better. Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, we want you to feel like you belong here. We provide flexible working options to support you and how you can contribute.

Be the leader you want to be

Some guide teams, some change culture, some build essential expertise. We offer opportunities and experiences that support your continuing growth as a leader.

Have as many careers as you want.

The next step is yours

At Deloitte, we are all about doing business inclusively – that starts with having diverse colleagues of all abilities. jobs.description:
About the Company

At Future Secure AI, we're building something genuinely new — and we're looking for people bold enough to build it with us. We work at the frontier of AI, tackling big, real-world problems for global enterprises across multiple industries, armed with state-of-the-art technology and a culture that prizes courage, rigor, and relentless curiosity. Our leadership team is entrepreneurial, experienced, and accessible, with an open-door policy that means you'll never be just a number here. We invest seriously in your growth because we know our success depends on yours. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry, push into uncharted territory, and do work that genuinely matters, Future Secure AI is the place for you.
About the Role

The purpose of this role is to orchestrate delivery across multiple production line pods on one or more customer accounts, aligning dependencies, timelines and priorities to keep a sharedprogram on track. Acting as a Way of Working coach at scale, the Technical Program Manager drives consistent practices, surfaces cross-use case risks, and removes systemic impediments so milestone commitments are met across every use case. 
Key Responsibilities

 You will be responsible for specific tasks and outcomes, including but not limited to: 
Planning & Release Management

Own the Cross-Use Case Release Plan for the production line(s): one living plan, updated weekly, with each use case's Design Review, Build, UAT and go-live and all dependencies on a single timeline. 
Sequence releases across a multi-quarter horizon spanning every use case on the account, including those not yet scoped, through to Hypercare. 

Delivery Accountability, RAID & Escalation

Own the production line-wide RAID picture, maintaining the risk register and Dependency Log across every active use case and driving resolution to closure. 

Be the point of contact for use case team challenges, receive escalations from Build Leads and Engagement Leads, and escalate to the APAC Delivery Leader where required. 

Dependency & Capacity Management

Spot where use cases compete for the same resource, platform support, customer attention or milestone; coach pods to resolve, and escalate unresolved conflicts to the Engagement Lead and Build Lead with impact and a priority recommendation. 

Own Capacity Mapping: a live view of who is allocated where and at what percentage across every use case, flagging over-allocation before a pod misses a commitment, with the Resource Manager and Operations Lead. 

Quality, Metrics & Reporting

Monitor Jira quality metrics per use case (defect rate, UAT pass rate, test coverage, production incidents), raising issues early when AI Co-Worker quality may be at risk. 

Produce one consistent read on account delivery health (milestones, dependencies, capacity, quality) for the Build Lead, Engagement Lead and AI Engineering Lead. 

Ceremonies, Coaching & Way of Working

Own the cross-use case ceremony set (weekly Scrum of Scrums, Sprint Health Reviews, Cross-Use Case Retrospectives with the Build Lead, and the Monthly Portfolio Review), observing pod ceremonies on rotation to coach. 

Foster the FSAI Way of Working, delivery standards, Jira hygiene and a solution-first mindset across pods, carrying what works in one pod across to the others. 

Authority, Tools & Environments

Hold named build-RACI accountability (Accountable for Build Readiness, Responsible for Platform Deployment Coordination) and own prioritization and sequencing when use cases compete. 

Own the subscription's artefacts (Release Plan, Capacity Map, Quality Scorecard, Dependency Log, Portfolio Hypercare Report), set up Jira and pod access, and coordinate UAT environments and the cross-use case go-live checklist. 

Relationships

Internal: Manage up and out to delivery leadership, Engagement Leads and Executive Directors; hold a trusted partnership with the Engagement Lead and flag resourcing risk early enough to act with the customer. 

External: Represent delivery health to customer sponsors and stakeholders, keeping the relationship focused on the account. 

  Key Requirements:

Demonstrated experience coordinating delivery across multiple concurrent Agile teams, ideally in a scaled or program environment 
Strong Agile delivery background (Scrum Master, RTE or Delivery Lead) with a record of coaching teams to predictable velocity 

Proven ability to own release planning, cross-team dependency management and portfolio capacity planning 

Able to hold accountability and influence without direct line authority, across peers, leads and executives 

Confident managing up and out to senior stakeholders, sponsors and program governance 

Advanced user of Jira and Confluence, with strong reporting and delivery-tooling hygiene 

A systems thinker who operates one level up, spotting cross-use case patterns before they surprise the account; AI, software or technology delivery experience preferred

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Kestra Financial is a wealth management platform dedicated to empowering independent financial professionals—including traditional and hybrid RIAs—to grow their businesses and deliver exceptional client service. We combine advanced business management technology with personalized consulting to provide unmatched scale, efficiency, and support. Our advisor-focused culture is built on innovation and advocacy, enabling advisors to offer comprehensive securities and investment advisory solutions to their clients

Lead with Purpose. Partner with Impact

Kestra Financial, a leading provider of wealth management platforms, technology solutions, and investment products empowering independent financial advisors and RIAs nationwide, is seeking a Senior Strategic Implementation Manager.

This role serves as a pivotal execution leader accountable for the disciplined delivery of Kestra Wealth Management’s highest-priority strategic initiatives in investment products and platform capabilities. You will drive the successful launch of new investment products and manage end-to-end launch campaigns while coordinating complex cross-functional projects spanning technology, compliance, business development, and operations.

By implementing and championing agile, Scrum-like cadences and robust portfolio governance practices, you will build transparency, predictability, and accountability across initiatives. Your leadership will ensure that strategic intent translates into measurable business outcomes—including accelerated advisor adoption, revenue contribution from new products, enhanced platform capabilities, and operational excellence.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for a collaborative leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and cross-functional influence in a dynamic, growth-oriented wealth management environment.

What You’ll Do:

Own the end-to-end governance and planning that results in successful delivery of priority investment product launches (e.g., alternative investment solutions, insurance products, or curated offerings) and strategic platform implementation initiatives (new advisory revenue vertical, investment program redesign, etc) from concept through post-launch optimization and benefits realization.
Lead the coordination and execution of comprehensive launch campaigns, aligning go-to-market activities including sales enablement, marketing communications, advisor training and onboarding programs, distribution strategy, and adoption tracking to drive rapid uptake and sustained engagement.
Establish and maintain a prioritized portfolio of strategic initiatives for Investment Platforms & Products; drive rigorous sequencing, capacity alignment, funding discipline, and proactive trade-off decisions (scope, timeline, resources, investment) aligned to Kestra’s business objectives and growth priorities.
Partner with Product Management to translate product strategy and roadmap into executable implementation plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and success criteria.
Support Wealth Management platform and product leads by facilitating high-performing cross-functional project teams and workstreams involving:
Technology: Platform development, data integrations (including MDM/medallion architectures), APIs, advisor portals/tools, and infrastructure enhancements.
Compliance & Legal: Product due diligence, regulatory reviews/approvals, disclosures, risk assessments, and ongoing product governance to ensure adherence to SEC, FINRA, fiduciary, and other requirements.
Business: Commercialization strategy, RIA/advisor engagement and feedback loops, distribution channel readiness, pricing/packaging, and P&L impact modeling.
Operations & Finance: Operational readiness, process design, financial tracking, and benefits measurement.
Map and manage complex dependencies, risks, and interdependencies across teams; proactively identify and remove blockers while fostering alignment and shared ownership in a matrixed environment.
Ensure every initiative incorporates appropriate compliance guardrails, risk controls, audit readiness, and change management from the start.
Design, implement, and continuously mature agile delivery operating models tailored to regulated investment product and platform initiatives. This includes establishing Scrum-like cadences (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives), Kanban for workflow transparency and flow optimization, and scaled frameworks (e.g., program-level planning or release management) for larger or interdependent efforts.
Stand up consistent governance rhythms and forums, including steering committees, launch readiness reviews/tollgates, dependency management sessions, risk reviews, and clear escalation paths to executive leadership.
Drive adoption of modern agile/project tools (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent) and best practices to improve delivery velocity, predictability, collaboration, and quality across technology and business teams.
Champion a shift toward iterative, outcome-focused delivery—balancing the need for structure and compliance in product launches with the speed and adaptability required in a competitive wealth tech landscape.
Build and operate a portfolio “control tower” capability: deliver timely, credible, decision-oriented reporting and dashboards on initiative status, milestones, risks/issues, dependencies, financial performance (budget vs. plan, ROI tracking), and leading indicators of business impact.
Define, track, and report on key business outcome metrics tied to each strategic initiative (e.g., new product net flows/AUM/revenue contribution, advisor adoption and usage rates, client/advisor satisfaction or NPS impact, reduction in time-to-market or launch cycle time, compliance adherence, platform feature utilization and engagement).
Proactively surface execution risks, capacity constraints, and recommended trade-offs to senior leadership; lead structured issue resolution, corrective action planning, and recovery efforts to protect delivery commitments and protect/enhance business results.
Prepare and present high-quality materials for executive leadership, steering committees, and governance forums; represent the delivery health and outlook of the Investment Platforms & Products portfolio with clarity and fact-based insights.
Instill a culture of genuine accountability—where teams own and are measured on the delivery of agreed business outcomes and value realization, not merely activity completion or milestone hitting.

What You Bring: 

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or Software Engineering.
2+ years experience in technical product management in an Agile environment.
5+ years of experience in wealth management, investment operations, or trading
3-5+ years of progressive leadership experience in strategic program/portfolio management, product implementation, launch execution, or enterprise transformation roles within wealth management, RIA platforms, investment product development, fintech, asset/wealth platforms, or similarly complex, regulated financial services environments.
Demonstrated success leading multiple end-to-end launches of investment products or major platform capabilities, including coordination across technology builds, compliance/regulatory approvals, and go-to-market execution
Direct experience with alternatives/private markets access, model portfolios, structured solutions, or advisor-facing technology platforms within a broker dealer organization is strongly preferred.
Track record of successfully implementing or significantly maturing agile delivery practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, hybrid, or tailored approaches) in product development or regulated contexts, with quantifiable improvements in predictability, velocity, and time-to-value.

Certifications and Licenses:

Series 7 , 63 or 66 required within 2 years.
Series 65 preferred

Internal Application Policy:

Internal applicants must be in good standing and have a minimum of 1 year of service with Kestra. Internal applicants must also have a minimum of 1 year service in current role unless approved by EVP.

Benefits to support you:

Competitive pay and benefits with a large employer (over 1600 employees nationwide)
401(k), health insurance, and a competitive benefits package
Work in a supportive, collaborative environment committed to professional excellence
Help clients navigate meaningful financial decisions with confidence
Opportunities for training, development, and long-term growth within the firm
Tuition reimbursement for qualified expenses

Kestra Values:

Our Mission is Powering Financial Independence, enabling the growth and success of investing clients and the advisors who serve them. We do that by living our values: Serve, Make it Happen, and One team.

Apply Today

Lead with purpose. Apply now and help shape the future of Kestra.

jobs.description:
About the Company

At Future Secure AI, we're building something genuinely new — and we're looking for people bold enough to build it with us. We work at the frontier of AI, tackling big, real-world problems for global enterprises across multiple industries, armed with state-of-the-art technology and a culture that prizes courage, rigor, and relentless curiosity. Our BRAVER values aren't just words on a wall — they describe the kind of people we are and the standard we hold ourselves to every day. Our leadership team is entrepreneurial, experienced, and accessible, with an open-door policy that means you'll never be just a number here. We invest seriously in your growth because we know our success depends on yours. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry, push into uncharted territory, and do work that genuinely matters, Future Secure AI is the place for you.
About the Role

The purpose of this role is to orchestrate delivery across multiple production line pods on one or more customer accounts, aligning dependencies, timelines and priorities to keep a sharedprogram on track. Acting as a Way of Working coach at scale, the Technical Program Manager drives consistent practices, surfaces cross-use case risks, and removes systemic impediments so milestone commitments are met across every use case. 
Key Responsibilities

 You will be responsible for specific tasks and outcomes, including but not limited to: 
Planning & Release Management

Own the Cross-Use Case Release Plan for the production line(s): one living plan, updated weekly, with each use case's Design Review, Build, UAT and go-live and all dependencies on a single timeline. 
Sequence releases across a multi-quarter horizon spanning every use case on the account, including those not yet scoped, through to Hypercare. 

Delivery Accountability, RAID & Escalation

Own the production line-wide RAID picture, maintaining the risk register and Dependency Log across every active use case and driving resolution to closure. 

Be the point of contact for use case team challenges, receive escalations from Build Leads and Engagement Leads, and escalate to the APAC Delivery Leader where required. 

Dependency & Capacity Management

Spot where use cases compete for the same resource, platform support, customer attention or milestone; coach pods to resolve, and escalate unresolved conflicts to the Engagement Lead and Build Lead with impact and a priority recommendation. 

Own Capacity Mapping: a live view of who is allocated where and at what percentage across every use case, flagging over-allocation before a pod misses a commitment, with the Resource Manager and Operations Lead. 

Quality, Metrics & Reporting

Monitor Jira quality metrics per use case (defect rate, UAT pass rate, test coverage, production incidents), raising issues early when AI Co-Worker quality may be at risk. 

Produce one consistent read on account delivery health (milestones, dependencies, capacity, quality) for the Build Lead, Engagement Lead and AI Engineering Lead. 

Ceremonies, Coaching & Way of Working

Own the cross-use case ceremony set (weekly Scrum of Scrums, Sprint Health Reviews, Cross-Use Case Retrospectives with the Build Lead, and the Monthly Portfolio Review), observing pod ceremonies on rotation to coach. 

Foster the FSAI Way of Working, delivery standards, Jira hygiene and a solution-first mindset across pods, carrying what works in one pod across to the others. 

Authority, Tools & Environments

Hold named build-RACI accountability (Accountable for Build Readiness, Responsible for Platform Deployment Coordination) and own prioritization and sequencing when use cases compete. 

Own the subscription's artefacts (Release Plan, Capacity Map, Quality Scorecard, Dependency Log, Portfolio Hypercare Report), set up Jira and pod access, and coordinate UAT environments and the cross-use case go-live checklist. 

Relationships

Internal: Manage up and out to delivery leadership, Engagement Leads and Executive Directors; hold a trusted partnership with the Engagement Lead and flag resourcing risk early enough to act with the customer. 

External: Represent delivery health to customer sponsors and stakeholders, keeping the relationship focused on the account. 

  Key Requirements:

Demonstrated experience coordinating delivery across multiple concurrent Agile teams, ideally in a scaled or program environment 
Strong Agile delivery background (Scrum Master, RTE or Delivery Lead) with a record of coaching teams to predictable velocity 

Proven ability to own release planning, cross-team dependency management and portfolio capacity planning 

Able to hold accountability and influence without direct line authority, across peers, leads and executives 

Confident managing up and out to senior stakeholders, sponsors and program governance 

Advanced user of Jira and Confluence, with strong reporting and delivery-tooling hygiene 

A systems thinker who operates one level up, spotting cross-use case patterns before they surprise the account; AI, software or technology delivery experience preferred

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Kestra Financial is a wealth management platform dedicated to empowering independent financial professionals—including traditional and hybrid RIAs—to grow their businesses and deliver exceptional client service. We combine advanced business management technology with personalized consulting to provide unmatched scale, efficiency, and support. Our advisor-focused culture is built on innovation and advocacy, enabling advisors to offer comprehensive securities and investment advisory solutions to their clients

Lead with Purpose. Partner with Impact

Kestra Financial, a leading provider of wealth management platforms, technology solutions, and investment products empowering independent financial advisors and RIAs nationwide, is seeking a Senior Strategic Implementation Manager.

This role serves as a pivotal execution leader accountable for the disciplined delivery of Kestra Wealth Management’s highest-priority strategic initiatives in investment products and platform capabilities. You will drive the successful launch of new investment products and manage end-to-end launch campaigns while coordinating complex cross-functional projects spanning technology, compliance, business development, and operations.

By implementing and championing agile, Scrum-like cadences and robust portfolio governance practices, you will build transparency, predictability, and accountability across initiatives. Your leadership will ensure that strategic intent translates into measurable business outcomes—including accelerated advisor adoption, revenue contribution from new products, enhanced platform capabilities, and operational excellence.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for a collaborative leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and cross-functional influence in a dynamic, growth-oriented wealth management environment.

What You’ll Do:

Own the end-to-end governance and planning that results in successful delivery of priority investment product launches (e.g., alternative investment solutions, insurance products, or curated offerings) and strategic platform implementation initiatives (new advisory revenue vertical, investment program redesign, etc) from concept through post-launch optimization and benefits realization.
Lead the coordination and execution of comprehensive launch campaigns, aligning go-to-market activities including sales enablement, marketing communications, advisor training and onboarding programs, distribution strategy, and adoption tracking to drive rapid uptake and sustained engagement.
Establish and maintain a prioritized portfolio of strategic initiatives for Investment Platforms & Products; drive rigorous sequencing, capacity alignment, funding discipline, and proactive trade-off decisions (scope, timeline, resources, investment) aligned to Kestra’s business objectives and growth priorities.
Partner with Product Management to translate product strategy and roadmap into executable implementation plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and success criteria.
Support Wealth Management platform and product leads by facilitating high-performing cross-functional project teams and workstreams involving:
Technology: Platform development, data integrations (including MDM/medallion architectures), APIs, advisor portals/tools, and infrastructure enhancements.
Compliance & Legal: Product due diligence, regulatory reviews/approvals, disclosures, risk assessments, and ongoing product governance to ensure adherence to SEC, FINRA, fiduciary, and other requirements.
Business: Commercialization strategy, RIA/advisor engagement and feedback loops, distribution channel readiness, pricing/packaging, and P&L impact modeling.
Operations & Finance: Operational readiness, process design, financial tracking, and benefits measurement.
Map and manage complex dependencies, risks, and interdependencies across teams; proactively identify and remove blockers while fostering alignment and shared ownership in a matrixed environment.
Ensure every initiative incorporates appropriate compliance guardrails, risk controls, audit readiness, and change management from the start.
Design, implement, and continuously mature agile delivery operating models tailored to regulated investment product and platform initiatives. This includes establishing Scrum-like cadences (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives), Kanban for workflow transparency and flow optimization, and scaled frameworks (e.g., program-level planning or release management) for larger or interdependent efforts.
Stand up consistent governance rhythms and forums, including steering committees, launch readiness reviews/tollgates, dependency management sessions, risk reviews, and clear escalation paths to executive leadership.
Drive adoption of modern agile/project tools (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent) and best practices to improve delivery velocity, predictability, collaboration, and quality across technology and business teams.
Champion a shift toward iterative, outcome-focused delivery—balancing the need for structure and compliance in product launches with the speed and adaptability required in a competitive wealth tech landscape.
Build and operate a portfolio “control tower” capability: deliver timely, credible, decision-oriented reporting and dashboards on initiative status, milestones, risks/issues, dependencies, financial performance (budget vs. plan, ROI tracking), and leading indicators of business impact.
Define, track, and report on key business outcome metrics tied to each strategic initiative (e.g., new product net flows/AUM/revenue contribution, advisor adoption and usage rates, client/advisor satisfaction or NPS impact, reduction in time-to-market or launch cycle time, compliance adherence, platform feature utilization and engagement).
Proactively surface execution risks, capacity constraints, and recommended trade-offs to senior leadership; lead structured issue resolution, corrective action planning, and recovery efforts to protect delivery commitments and protect/enhance business results.
Prepare and present high-quality materials for executive leadership, steering committees, and governance forums; represent the delivery health and outlook of the Investment Platforms & Products portfolio with clarity and fact-based insights.
Instill a culture of genuine accountability—where teams own and are measured on the delivery of agreed business outcomes and value realization, not merely activity completion or milestone hitting.

What You Bring: 

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or Software Engineering.
2+ years experience in technical product management in an Agile environment.
5+ years of experience in wealth management, investment operations, or trading
3-5+ years of progressive leadership experience in strategic program/portfolio management, product implementation, launch execution, or enterprise transformation roles within wealth management, RIA platforms, investment product development, fintech, asset/wealth platforms, or similarly complex, regulated financial services environments.
Demonstrated success leading multiple end-to-end launches of investment products or major platform capabilities, including coordination across technology builds, compliance/regulatory approvals, and go-to-market execution
Direct experience with alternatives/private markets access, model portfolios, structured solutions, or advisor-facing technology platforms within a broker dealer organization is strongly preferred.
Track record of successfully implementing or significantly maturing agile delivery practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, hybrid, or tailored approaches) in product development or regulated contexts, with quantifiable improvements in predictability, velocity, and time-to-value.

Certifications and Licenses:

Series 7 , 63 or 66 required within 2 years.
Series 65 preferred

Internal applicants must be in good standing and have a minimum of 1 year of service with Kestra. Internal applicants must also have a minimum of 1 year service in current role unless approved by EVP.

Benefits to support you:

Competitive pay and benefits with a large employer (over 1600 employees nationwide)
401(k), health insurance, and a competitive benefits package
Work in a supportive, collaborative environment committed to professional excellence
Help clients navigate meaningful financial decisions with confidence
Opportunities for training, development, and long-term growth within the firm
Tuition reimbursement for qualified expenses

Kestra Values:

Our Mission is Powering Financial Independence, enabling the growth and success of investing clients and the advisors who serve them. We do that by living our values: Serve, Make it Happen, and One team.

jobs.title: Principal Project Manager - Transmission and Substation (EPC)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

We're powering a cleaner, brighter future.

Exelon is leading the energy transformation, and we're calling all problem solvers, innovators, community builders and change makers. Work with us to deliver solutions that make our diverse cities and communities stronger, healthier and more resilient.

We're powered by purpose-driven people like you who believe in being inclusive and creative, and value safety, innovation, integrity and community service. We are a Fortune 200 company, 20,000 colleagues strong serving more than 10.7 million customers at six energy companies -- Atlantic City Electric (ACE), Baltimore Gas and Electric (BGE), Commonwealth Edison (ComEd), Delmarva Power & Light (DPL), PECO Energy Company (PECO), and Potomac Electric Power Company (Pepco).

We're committed to creating an environment where every person can thrive. Our employee experience is grounded in four tenets that guide how we support our people: purposeful careers, growth opportunities, community impact, and support to thrive.

In our relentless pursuit of excellence, we elevate diverse voices, fresh perspectives and bold thinking. And since we know transforming the future of energy is hard work, we provide competitive compensation, incentives, excellent benefits and the opportunity to build a rewarding career.

Are you in?

Primary Purpose

Manage complex transmission, substation, distribution, gas, and/or information technology projects consisting of cross-functional teams involving multiple disciplines and multiple operating areas including contract resources. Responsible for managing the scope, schedule, budget and safety performance of multiple projects and programs. Leads project teams through business case / capital approval process, development and execution of project plans and project closeout. These projects have budgets that will typically range from $1 million to $60 million. Also, may manage high profile business initiative projects with direct accountability for project execution while leading a team to accomplish project objectives within a given time frame and with limited resources.

Position may be required to work extended hours for coverage during storms or other energy delivery emergencies.

Primary Duties

Manages large and/or highly complex and often unique projects requiring application of established project management principles and techniques. Directly accountable to deliver project on time and at or below budget.
Key interface for external customer work involving transmission and substation projects including presentation of billable costs to the customer and negotiating schedules.
Collaborate with other project managers, work management, and functional managers to assure optimal utilization of resources.
Primary communicator with the project sponsor and key stakeholders on project issues including executive level presentations.
Acquire and manage contract resources by participating in the contractor selection process, prepare contact requisitions, approve change orders and contract payment authorizations and evaluate contractor performance.
Lead and coach team members to improve performance and meet or exceed expectations. Mentor less experienced colleagues.
Acquire zoning variations and permits for large projects by presenting project details to city zoning boards and public hearings.
Perform backup role for Manager Project Management.

Job Scope

The Project Manager is an individual contributor accountable for project budgets, team performance and developing strategic plans to implement projects for various organizations. Responsibilities also include managing scope, budget and schedule to within approved parameters and providing structured and detailed reports to the appropriate Management team. Tasks may include but are not limited to, ensuring the completion of business cases, budgetary approvals, project scheduling, requirements engineering, design and engineering tasks, vegetation management reviews, project reporting, project financial analysis, major equipment procurement, environmental analysis, obtaining real estate and relationship management with large customers, vendors, townships and regulatory agencies, project quality assurance, and change management. Interacts routinely with key internal and external stakeholders including senior management, energy delivery's largest customers, and governmental and regulatory officials. Under little to no supervision, manages multiple projects of complex, large scope and budget. May manage a total portfolio of active projects or annual programs of complex, large scope and budget.

Minimum Qualifications

For construction project management: Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field and 7-10 years relevant project management or related experience, OR in lieu of Bachelor's degree, 9-12 years relevant project management or related experience; For non-construction project management: Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or related field and 7-10 years relevant project management or related experience, OR in lieu of Bachelor's degree, 9-12 years or relevant project management or related experience.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or achieve PMP within two years of job entry
Demonstrated proficiency and experience managing large, complex projects using project management techniques including: A. Planning and Control (product /work breakdown structures, critical path analysis, scope control techniques) B. Issue and Risk Management (identification, assessment and management of project risks including contingency plans) C. Project Management Tools (methods and techniques for planning, scheduling, resource balancing, monitoring cost) D. Business Case Development (cost/benefit evaluations including net present value analysis) E. Progress Reporting (cost/schedule curves, project status report, earned value analysis)
Proven leadership ability in a high-performance culture
Demonstrated ability to build consensus, communicate effectively, engage others in the required processes, and hold people accountable
Valid driver's license and access to an automobile

Preferred Qualifications

PMP-certified professional with 5–8 years of experience managing complex projects valued at over $25 million and spanning multiple years.
Minimum 3 years of experience working on EPC contracts as an owner or EPC contractor must showcase in-depth knowledge of how the EPC contracts were structured and how that impacted the owner or contractor.
Strong understanding of the EPC model, gained through direct experience working for an EPC contractor or managing EPC projects
Strict attention to detail, proven ability to review, analyze, and validate time and material-based contracts, reviewing with utmost prudency. Must demonstrate a questioning attitude, not shy about questioning contractors and must always act in the best interest of Exelon and its affiliates.
Incredible documentation on all project-related matters, including meeting minutes, action items, critical documents, emails, etc.
Deep-rooted knowledge of schedules and earned value management
Critical path method (CPM), successor predecessor relationships.
Must have a strong ability to communicate with all stakeholders to effectively oversee creation of a logic-tied project schedule (does not need to work in scheduling software but must be able to showcase ability to lead push pull planning, CPM, or other schedule-based meetings).
In-depth understanding of risk registers and identifying project risks, ability to work through mitigation methods with other stakeholders (internal and external) to define a working risk register for the project.
Must be able to monitor risks and understand when risks have passed and clearly document if mitigation was used or if risk dissolved, how to reallocate or remove contingency, how to anticipate new project risks and mitigation methods, and finally demonstrate how to react when unforeseen risks have arisen.
Strong financial acumen, being able to cashflow a project throughout its lifecycle and monitor control financial vulnerability.
Full ownership of project budget experience, accountable for all aspects of project financials; authorization, forecasting, long range budgeting.
Demonstrates strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, along with the leadership qualities needed to guide cross-functional teams to meet or exceed project goals related to schedule, cost, and quality.
Strategic thinker to align project execution with broader organizational goals and long-term objectives.
Ability to work independently and identify parallel and serial work streams, be a self-starter and require little no guidance for daily responsibilities, work independently and self-manage project work with minimal managerial oversight.
Experience with executing high‑voltage transmission or substation projects (e.g., 138kV and above).
Familiarity with MISO, PJM, or other regional transmission organization (RTO) programs.
Experience with EPC, CM‑at‑Risk, or alliance‑style contracting models.
Knowledge of CPCN‑driven projects, environmental permitting, and land acquisition interfaces.
Experience operating within utility governance models, cost controls, and regulatory frameworks.

Über unseren Mandanten

Unser Mandant ist ein europäisches IoT-Unternehmen, das Ladungsträger wie Paletten, Rollcontainer und Mehrwegbehälter mit Sensorik ausstattet und daraus komplette Lösungen für die Lieferkette baut: Hardware, Konnektivität, Plattform und Auswertung aus einer Hand. Kunden aus Handel, FMCG-Produktion, Logistik und Pooling sehen damit erstmals durchgehend, wo ihre Assets sind, wie sie sich bewegen und an welcher Übergabe sie verloren gehen. Nach erfolgreichen Projekten in den Benelux-Staaten und Großbritannien startet jetzt der Aufbau der DACH-Region, mit einer bereits gefüllten Pipeline bei namhaften Handelsketten und Getränkeherstellern.

Die Rolle

Sie verantworten technische Kundenprojekte von der Übergabe aus dem Vertrieb bis zur Abnahme. Sie übersetzen die Anforderungen des Kunden in eine technisch umsetzbare Lösung, koordinieren Hardware, Software, Konnektivität, Konfiguration, Daten und Integrationen und steuern anschließend die Umsetzung vor Ort.
Sie sind die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde, internen Technikteams und externen Partnern. Das bedeutet an einem Tag ein Requirements-Workshop im Verteilzentrum, am nächsten die Abstimmung mit der IT des Kunden über die ERP-Anbindung und am dritten die Einsatzplanung für die Montage von mehreren Tausend Beacons.
Es ist die erste Position dieser Art in der DACH-Region. Sie arbeiten eigenständig, mit fachlicher Anbindung und Rückendeckung aus den Niederlanden.

Ihre Aufgaben

End-to-End-Verantwortung für technische Kundenprojekte: Scope, Planung, Budget, Qualität, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten
Analyse der Kundenumgebung und des Use Case, Übersetzung in eine konkrete technische Lösung auf Basis der bestehenden Produktbausteine
Erhebung und Validierung fachlicher und technischer Anforderungen, Überführung in Arbeitspakete, Meilensteine und Abnahmekriterien
Steuerung von Integrationen und Schnittstellen zu Kundensystemen, unter anderem ERP, WMS und TMS
Planung und Begleitung von Rollouts: Installation, Konfiguration, Inbetriebnahme, Test und Abnahme, inklusive Koordination von Montagedienstleistern und Vorbereitung der Einsätze vor Ort
Management von Risiken, Issues und Änderungen sowie deren Auswirkungen auf Zeitplan und Kundenvereinbarungen
Erwartungsmanagement beim Kunden und Unterstützung der Kollegen aus dem Vertrieb bei technischen Fragen
Saubere Projektdokumentation und geordnete Übergabe an den Betrieb, unter Beachtung der ISO-9001- und ISO-27001-Vorgaben
Rückspiegelung von Erfahrungen aus der Umsetzung an Produkt und Technik, damit die Lösungen weiter skalieren

Ihr Profil

Das sollten Sie mitbringen

Rund 5–10 Jahre Erfahrung im technischen Projektmanagement, in Technical Delivery, Solution Engineering oder Systemintegration
Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit komplexen technischen Kundenimplementierungen von der Anforderung bis zur Abnahme
Erfahrung in Umgebungen, in denen Hardware, Software, Konnektivität und Daten zusammenkommen, etwa IoT, Sensorik, Telematik, RFID, OT oder Intralogistik-Automatisierung
Sicherheit im Umgang mit Integrationen, Schnittstellen und APIs
Erfahrung in der Steuerung interner Teams, Lieferanten und Partner ohne disziplinarische Führung
Hands-on-Mentalität: Sie steuern nicht nur aus dem Projektplan, sondern sind auch im Lager oder Verteilzentrum präsent
Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und verhandlungssicheres Englisch
Wohnsitz im Raum Frankfurt oder Bereitschaft zum Umzug

Das ist ein deutliches Plus

Domänenwissen aus der Supply Chain im FMCG- oder Handelsumfeld: Verteilzentren, Ladungsträger, Pooling, Transport
Erfahrung mit ERP-, WMS- oder TMS-Umgebungen
Erfahrung mit Requirements Engineering, technischer Validierung, Test und Abnahme sowie mit Root-Cause-Analysen

Sie müssen kein Funk- oder Signaltechnik-Experte sein. Wichtig ist, dass Sie die Technik so weit durchdringen, dass Sie die richtigen Fragen stellen, Abhängigkeiten erkennen und rechtzeitig die passenden Spezialisten einbinden.

Was geboten wird

Die erste Delivery-Rolle in einer neu aufgebauten Region, mit entsprechendem Gestaltungsspielraum
Großprojekte mit namhaften Kunden aus Handel und FMCG, die gerade vom Pilotstadium in den Rollout gehen
Ein Produkt, das messbaren Nutzen liefert, statt einer weiteren Softwarelizenz
Büro in Frankfurt mit 2–3 Präsenztagen pro Woche, flexibel abhängig von Kundenterminen
Firmenwagen (elektrisch) und ein marktgerechtes Gesamtpaket
Kurze Wege in eine internationale Organisation mit Sitz in den Niederlanden

RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe and Asia - Pacific. Today we are more than 400 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.

Do you have experience in project management and want to improve cancer care for patients around the world? Join RaySearch's development department as a project manager!
About the position

As a project manager at RaySearch you will be part of the team that is responsible for planning, leading and documenting product development projects, ensuring that we provide our customers with state-of-the-art oncology software. We work according to agile methodologies and with close collaboration between projects and departments within RaySearch.

Plan the development projects and product releases together with fellow project management team members, collaborating both within the own project and across other projects and products
Follow up project progress continuously together with the development teams
Continuously work together with the development teams to improve processes and ways of working as well as to remove impediments

jobs.description:
About the Company

At Future Secure AI, we're building something genuinely new — and we're looking for people bold enough to build it with us. We work at the frontier of AI, tackling big, real-world problems for global enterprises across multiple industries, armed with state-of-the-art technology and a culture that prizes courage, rigor, and relentless curiosity. Our BRAVER values aren't just words on a wall — they describe the kind of people we are and the standard we hold ourselves to every day. Our leadership team is entrepreneurial, experienced, and accessible, with an open-door policy that means you'll never be just a number here. We invest seriously in your growth because we know our success depends on yours. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry, push into uncharted territory, and do work that genuinely matters, Future Secure AI is the place for you.
About the Role

The purpose of this role is to orchestrate delivery across multiple production line pods on one or more customer accounts, aligning dependencies, timelines and priorities to keep a sharedprogram on track. Acting as a Way of Working coach at scale, the Technical Program Manager drives consistent practices, surfaces cross-use case risks, and removes systemic impediments so milestone commitments are met across every use case. 
Key Responsibilities

 You will be responsible for specific tasks and outcomes, including but not limited to: 
Planning & Release Management

Own the Cross-Use Case Release Plan for the production line(s): one living plan, updated weekly, with each use case's Design Review, Build, UAT and go-live and all dependencies on a single timeline. 
Sequence releases across a multi-quarter horizon spanning every use case on the account, including those not yet scoped, through to Hypercare. 

Delivery Accountability, RAID & Escalation

Own the production line-wide RAID picture, maintaining the risk register and Dependency Log across every active use case and driving resolution to closure. 

Be the point of contact for use case team challenges, receive escalations from Build Leads and Engagement Leads, and escalate to the APAC Delivery Leader where required. 

Dependency & Capacity Management

Spot where use cases compete for the same resource, platform support, customer attention or milestone; coach pods to resolve, and escalate unresolved conflicts to the Engagement Lead and Build Lead with impact and a priority recommendation. 

Own Capacity Mapping: a live view of who is allocated where and at what percentage across every use case, flagging over-allocation before a pod misses a commitment, with the Resource Manager and Operations Lead. 

Quality, Metrics & Reporting

Monitor Jira quality metrics per use case (defect rate, UAT pass rate, test coverage, production incidents), raising issues early when AI Co-Worker quality may be at risk. 

Produce one consistent read on account delivery health (milestones, dependencies, capacity, quality) for the Build Lead, Engagement Lead and AI Engineering Lead. 

Ceremonies, Coaching & Way of Working

Own the cross-use case ceremony set (weekly Scrum of Scrums, Sprint Health Reviews, Cross-Use Case Retrospectives with the Build Lead, and the Monthly Portfolio Review), observing pod ceremonies on rotation to coach. 

Foster the FSAI Way of Working, delivery standards, Jira hygiene and a solution-first mindset across pods, carrying what works in one pod across to the others. 

Authority, Tools & Environments

Hold named build-RACI accountability (Accountable for Build Readiness, Responsible for Platform Deployment Coordination) and own prioritization and sequencing when use cases compete. 

Own the subscription's artefacts (Release Plan, Capacity Map, Quality Scorecard, Dependency Log, Portfolio Hypercare Report), set up Jira and pod access, and coordinate UAT environments and the cross-use case go-live checklist. 

Relationships

Internal: Manage up and out to delivery leadership, Engagement Leads and Executive Directors; hold a trusted partnership with the Engagement Lead and flag resourcing risk early enough to act with the customer. 

External: Represent delivery health to customer sponsors and stakeholders, keeping the relationship focused on the account. 

  Key Requirements:

Demonstrated experience coordinating delivery across multiple concurrent Agile teams, ideally in a scaled or program environment 
Strong Agile delivery background (Scrum Master, RTE or Delivery Lead) with a record of coaching teams to predictable velocity 

Proven ability to own release planning, cross-team dependency management and portfolio capacity planning 

Able to hold accountability and influence without direct line authority, across peers, leads and executives 

Confident managing up and out to senior stakeholders, sponsors and program governance 

Advanced user of Jira and Confluence, with strong reporting and delivery-tooling hygiene 

A systems thinker who operates one level up, spotting cross-use case patterns before they surprise the account; AI, software or technology delivery experience preferred

Our Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal data when you visit our website at   www.futuresecure.ai   (the "Website") and use our services.

At Leidos Australia, our work goes beyond a job title. We design, build, operate and support the systems, services and capabilities that help protect and advance the Australian way of life.

Backed by a global organisation of more than 40,000 people, our Australian team of around 2,000 has partnered with government, defence and national security customers for more than 30 years. We deliver mission-critical solutions where reliability, trust and purpose matter.

Benefits

Leidos is a destination for people who want their work to have purpose, their contribution to be recognised, and their career to grow without needing to fit a single mould. Meaningful work is supported by benefits, flexibility and career pathways that help you grow while balancing life outside work. This includes:

Flex Your Way – Tailor work to your life with options including Life Days (up to 12 extra days off per year), part-time arrangements, job sharing, and compressed hours.
Wellbeing That Matters – Free access to Headspace and MeQuilibrium, plus dedicated wellness spaces to support your mental, physical, and emotional wellbeing.
Learn Without Limits – Access over 120,000 on-demand courses, alongside technical, project management, leadership, and professional development opportunities.
Work That Makes an Impact – Contribute to nationally significant projects that matter, solve complex challenges, and accelerate your career through unique growth opportunities.
Build Your Future – Whether you're deepening technical expertise or preparing for leadership, we'll invest in your development every step of the way.
And Much More – These are just a few of the ways we invest in our people and help them thrive.

About The Team

You’ll join a team where people work with integrity, inclusion, innovation, agility, collaboration and commitment. In practice, that means sharing ownership, solving complex problems together and staying connected to the customer context, the purpose behind the work and how each role contributes to meaningful outcomes.

We deliver secure, resilient and innovative technology services that enable Defence enterprise and warfighting capabilities across multiple classified domains and networks. We provide world-class ICT operations and agile digital modernisation using advanced analytics, automation, hybrid cloud, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, cybersecurity and AI to optimise highly complex, mission-critical environments .

The Opportunity

Leidos is seeking an experienced and delivery-focused Project Manager to lead a portfolio of concurrent Survey and Quote (S&Q) projects within a complex Defence ICT environment. Working closely with software developers, systems engineers, testers, technical leaders, security specialists and customer stakeholders, you will translate approved work packages into practical delivery plans and guide projects from mobilisation through to acceptance and closure. This is a hands-on role that combines structured project governance with collaborative leadership to support successful customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the planning, mobilisation, execution, acceptance and closure of multiple concurrent S&Q projects and work packages.
Develop and maintain integrated delivery plans, schedules, resource forecasts and project controls to ensure successful delivery outcomes.
Provide day-to-day leadership for a multidisciplinary delivery squad, partnering with technical leaders to align project priorities and delivery activities.
Manage scope, budget, risks, issues, dependencies, changes and financial performance while maintaining visibility of delivery progress.
Build trusted stakeholder relationships and provide clear reporting, governance, review, assurance, testing and customer acceptance activities throughout the project lifecycle.

About You

We are looking for someone who brings judgement, curiosity and a collaborative approach to work that matters.

Demonstrated experience independently managing multiple ICT, software or systems projects through all phases of the project lifecycle.
Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and influence stakeholders within complex, matrixed environments.
Strong capability in project controls including scheduling, budgeting, forecasting, risk management, change management and governance reporting.
Experience working with Agile, iterative or hybrid delivery approaches and software development lifecycle practices.

This role requires the successful applicant to be an Australian citizen and hold, or be eligible to obtain, NV-2 security clearance.

If this role interests you, we encourage you to apply. We value different experiences and are interested in the capability and potential you could bring.

What to Expect When You Apply

Qualifications

Our hiring process is designed to be straightforward, respectful and easy to navigate. If your skills, experience and qualifications look aligned with the role, our Talent Acquisition team will contact you to discuss the next stage. You can expect:

An initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team
An interview with the hiring manager or interview panel

We’ll let you know what to expect before each stage, including who you’ll meet and how to prepare. If you need any adjustments or support during the process, please let us know.

Ready to explore what’s possible?

If this sounds like a role where you can make an impact and continue to grow, we’d like to hear from you. Please apply via the “Apply Now” button with your resume. If you have any questions about the role or recruitment process, please contact careers.au@au.leidos.com.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Original Posting

For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.

Pay Range

Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

Pay And Benefits

Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits.

Securing Your Data

Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work).
