Kestra Financial is a wealth management platform dedicated to empowering independent financial professionals—including traditional and hybrid RIAs—to grow their businesses and deliver exceptional client service. We combine advanced business management technology with personalized consulting to provide unmatched scale, efficiency, and support. Our advisor-focused culture is built on innovation and advocacy, enabling advisors to offer comprehensive securities and investment advisory solutions to their clients

Lead with Purpose. Partner with Impact

Kestra Financial, a leading provider of wealth management platforms, technology solutions, and investment products empowering independent financial advisors and RIAs nationwide, is seeking a Senior Strategic Implementation Manager.

This role serves as a pivotal execution leader accountable for the disciplined delivery of Kestra Wealth Management’s highest-priority strategic initiatives in investment products and platform capabilities. You will drive the successful launch of new investment products and manage end-to-end launch campaigns while coordinating complex cross-functional projects spanning technology, compliance, business development, and operations.

By implementing and championing agile, Scrum-like cadences and robust portfolio governance practices, you will build transparency, predictability, and accountability across initiatives. Your leadership will ensure that strategic intent translates into measurable business outcomes—including accelerated advisor adoption, revenue contribution from new products, enhanced platform capabilities, and operational excellence.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for a collaborative leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and cross-functional influence in a dynamic, growth-oriented wealth management environment.

What You’ll Do:

Own the end-to-end governance and planning that results in successful delivery of priority investment product launches (e.g., alternative investment solutions, insurance products, or curated offerings) and strategic platform implementation initiatives (new advisory revenue vertical, investment program redesign, etc) from concept through post-launch optimization and benefits realization.
Lead the coordination and execution of comprehensive launch campaigns, aligning go-to-market activities including sales enablement, marketing communications, advisor training and onboarding programs, distribution strategy, and adoption tracking to drive rapid uptake and sustained engagement.
Establish and maintain a prioritized portfolio of strategic initiatives for Investment Platforms & Products; drive rigorous sequencing, capacity alignment, funding discipline, and proactive trade-off decisions (scope, timeline, resources, investment) aligned to Kestra’s business objectives and growth priorities.
Partner with Product Management to translate product strategy and roadmap into executable implementation plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and success criteria.
Support Wealth Management platform and product leads by facilitating high-performing cross-functional project teams and workstreams involving:
Technology: Platform development, data integrations (including MDM/medallion architectures), APIs, advisor portals/tools, and infrastructure enhancements.
Compliance & Legal: Product due diligence, regulatory reviews/approvals, disclosures, risk assessments, and ongoing product governance to ensure adherence to SEC, FINRA, fiduciary, and other requirements.
Business: Commercialization strategy, RIA/advisor engagement and feedback loops, distribution channel readiness, pricing/packaging, and P&L impact modeling.
Operations & Finance: Operational readiness, process design, financial tracking, and benefits measurement.
Map and manage complex dependencies, risks, and interdependencies across teams; proactively identify and remove blockers while fostering alignment and shared ownership in a matrixed environment.
Ensure every initiative incorporates appropriate compliance guardrails, risk controls, audit readiness, and change management from the start.
Design, implement, and continuously mature agile delivery operating models tailored to regulated investment product and platform initiatives. This includes establishing Scrum-like cadences (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives), Kanban for workflow transparency and flow optimization, and scaled frameworks (e.g., program-level planning or release management) for larger or interdependent efforts.
Stand up consistent governance rhythms and forums, including steering committees, launch readiness reviews/tollgates, dependency management sessions, risk reviews, and clear escalation paths to executive leadership.
Drive adoption of modern agile/project tools (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent) and best practices to improve delivery velocity, predictability, collaboration, and quality across technology and business teams.
Champion a shift toward iterative, outcome-focused delivery—balancing the need for structure and compliance in product launches with the speed and adaptability required in a competitive wealth tech landscape.
Build and operate a portfolio “control tower” capability: deliver timely, credible, decision-oriented reporting and dashboards on initiative status, milestones, risks/issues, dependencies, financial performance (budget vs. plan, ROI tracking), and leading indicators of business impact.
Define, track, and report on key business outcome metrics tied to each strategic initiative (e.g., new product net flows/AUM/revenue contribution, advisor adoption and usage rates, client/advisor satisfaction or NPS impact, reduction in time-to-market or launch cycle time, compliance adherence, platform feature utilization and engagement).
Proactively surface execution risks, capacity constraints, and recommended trade-offs to senior leadership; lead structured issue resolution, corrective action planning, and recovery efforts to protect delivery commitments and protect/enhance business results.
Prepare and present high-quality materials for executive leadership, steering committees, and governance forums; represent the delivery health and outlook of the Investment Platforms & Products portfolio with clarity and fact-based insights.
Instill a culture of genuine accountability—where teams own and are measured on the delivery of agreed business outcomes and value realization, not merely activity completion or milestone hitting.

What You Bring: 

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or Software Engineering.
2+ years experience in technical product management in an Agile environment.
5+ years of experience in wealth management, investment operations, or trading
3-5+ years of progressive leadership experience in strategic program/portfolio management, product implementation, launch execution, or enterprise transformation roles within wealth management, RIA platforms, investment product development, fintech, asset/wealth platforms, or similarly complex, regulated financial services environments.
Demonstrated success leading multiple end-to-end launches of investment products or major platform capabilities, including coordination across technology builds, compliance/regulatory approvals, and go-to-market execution
Direct experience with alternatives/private markets access, model portfolios, structured solutions, or advisor-facing technology platforms within a broker dealer organization is strongly preferred.
Track record of successfully implementing or significantly maturing agile delivery practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, hybrid, or tailored approaches) in product development or regulated contexts, with quantifiable improvements in predictability, velocity, and time-to-value.

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

We're powering a cleaner, brighter future.

Exelon is leading the energy transformation, and we're calling all problem solvers, innovators, community builders and change makers. Work with us to deliver solutions that make our diverse cities and communities stronger, healthier and more resilient.

We're powered by purpose-driven people like you who believe in being inclusive and creative, and value safety, innovation, integrity and community service. We are a Fortune 200 company, 20,000 colleagues strong serving more than 10.7 million customers at six energy companies -- Atlantic City Electric (ACE), Baltimore Gas and Electric (BGE), Commonwealth Edison (ComEd), Delmarva Power & Light (DPL), PECO Energy Company (PECO), and Potomac Electric Power Company (Pepco).

We're committed to creating an environment where every person can thrive. Our employee experience is grounded in four tenets that guide how we support our people: purposeful careers, growth opportunities, community impact, and support to thrive.

In our relentless pursuit of excellence, we elevate diverse voices, fresh perspectives and bold thinking. And since we know transforming the future of energy is hard work, we provide competitive compensation, incentives, excellent benefits and the opportunity to build a rewarding career.

Are you in?

Primary Purpose

Manage complex transmission, substation, distribution, gas, and/or information technology projects consisting of cross-functional teams involving multiple disciplines and multiple operating areas including contract resources. Responsible for managing the scope, schedule, budget and safety performance of multiple projects and programs. Leads project teams through business case / capital approval process, development and execution of project plans and project closeout. These projects have budgets that will typically range from $1 million to $60 million. Also, may manage high profile business initiative projects with direct accountability for project execution while leading a team to accomplish project objectives within a given time frame and with limited resources.

Position may be required to work extended hours for coverage during storms or other energy delivery emergencies.

Primary Duties

Manages large and/or highly complex and often unique projects requiring application of established project management principles and techniques. Directly accountable to deliver project on time and at or below budget.
Key interface for external customer work involving transmission and substation projects including presentation of billable costs to the customer and negotiating schedules.
Collaborate with other project managers, work management, and functional managers to assure optimal utilization of resources.
Primary communicator with the project sponsor and key stakeholders on project issues including executive level presentations.
Acquire and manage contract resources by participating in the contractor selection process, prepare contact requisitions, approve change orders and contract payment authorizations and evaluate contractor performance.
Lead and coach team members to improve performance and meet or exceed expectations. Mentor less experienced colleagues.
Acquire zoning variations and permits for large projects by presenting project details to city zoning boards and public hearings.
Perform backup role for Manager Project Management.

Job Scope

The Project Manager is an individual contributor accountable for project budgets, team performance and developing strategic plans to implement projects for various organizations. Responsibilities also include managing scope, budget and schedule to within approved parameters and providing structured and detailed reports to the appropriate Management team. Tasks may include but are not limited to, ensuring the completion of business cases, budgetary approvals, project scheduling, requirements engineering, design and engineering tasks, vegetation management reviews, project reporting, project financial analysis, major equipment procurement, environmental analysis, obtaining real estate and relationship management with large customers, vendors, townships and regulatory agencies, project quality assurance, and change management. Interacts routinely with key internal and external stakeholders including senior management, energy delivery's largest customers, and governmental and regulatory officials. Under little to no supervision, manages multiple projects of complex, large scope and budget. May manage a total portfolio of active projects or annual programs of complex, large scope and budget.

Minimum Qualifications

For construction project management: Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field and 7-10 years relevant project management or related experience, OR in lieu of Bachelor's degree, 9-12 years relevant project management or related experience; For non-construction project management: Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or related field and 7-10 years relevant project management or related experience, OR in lieu of Bachelor's degree, 9-12 years or relevant project management or related experience.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or achieve PMP within two years of job entry
Demonstrated proficiency and experience managing large, complex projects using project management techniques including: A. Planning and Control (product /work breakdown structures, critical path analysis, scope control techniques) B. Issue and Risk Management (identification, assessment and management of project risks including contingency plans) C. Project Management Tools (methods and techniques for planning, scheduling, resource balancing, monitoring cost) D. Business Case Development (cost/benefit evaluations including net present value analysis) E. Progress Reporting (cost/schedule curves, project status report, earned value analysis)
Proven leadership ability in a high-performance culture
Demonstrated ability to build consensus, communicate effectively, engage others in the required processes, and hold people accountable
Valid driver's license and access to an automobile

Preferred Qualifications

PMP-certified professional with 5–8 years of experience managing complex projects valued at over $25 million and spanning multiple years.
Minimum 3 years of experience working on EPC contracts as an owner or EPC contractor must showcase in-depth knowledge of how the EPC contracts were structured and how that impacted the owner or contractor.
Strong understanding of the EPC model, gained through direct experience working for an EPC contractor or managing EPC projects
Strict attention to detail, proven ability to review, analyze, and validate time and material-based contracts, reviewing with utmost prudency. Must demonstrate a questioning attitude, not shy about questioning contractors and must always act in the best interest of Exelon and its affiliates.
Incredible documentation on all project-related matters, including meeting minutes, action items, critical documents, emails, etc.

new_jobs.description:
Über unseren Mandanten

Unser Mandant ist ein europäisches IoT-Unternehmen, das Ladungsträger wie Paletten, Rollcontainer und Mehrwegbehälter mit Sensorik ausstattet und daraus komplette Lösungen für die Lieferkette baut: Hardware, Konnektivität, Plattform und Auswertung aus einer Hand. Kunden aus Handel, FMCG-Produktion, Logistik und Pooling sehen damit erstmals durchgehend, wo ihre Assets sind, wie sie sich bewegen und an welcher Übergabe sie verloren gehen. Nach erfolgreichen Projekten in den Benelux-Staaten und Großbritannien startet jetzt der Aufbau der DACH-Region, mit einer bereits gefüllten Pipeline bei namhaften Handelsketten und Getränkeherstellern.

Die Rolle

Sie verantworten technische Kundenprojekte von der Übergabe aus dem Vertrieb bis zur Abnahme. Sie übersetzen die Anforderungen des Kunden in eine technisch umsetzbare Lösung, koordinieren Hardware, Software, Konnektivität, Konfiguration, Daten und Integrationen und steuern anschließend die Umsetzung vor Ort.
Sie sind die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde, internen Technikteams und externen Partnern. Das bedeutet an einem Tag ein Requirements-Workshop im Verteilzentrum, am nächsten die Abstimmung mit der IT des Kunden über die ERP-Anbindung und am dritten die Einsatzplanung für die Montage von mehreren Tausend Beacons.
Es ist die erste Position dieser Art in der DACH-Region. Sie arbeiten eigenständig, mit fachlicher Anbindung und Rückendeckung aus den Niederlanden.

Ihre Aufgaben

End-to-End-Verantwortung für technische Kundenprojekte: Scope, Planung, Budget, Qualität, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten
Analyse der Kundenumgebung und des Use Case, Übersetzung in eine konkrete technische Lösung auf Basis der bestehenden Produktbausteine
Erhebung und Validierung fachlicher und technischer Anforderungen, Überführung in Arbeitspakete, Meilensteine und Abnahmekriterien
Steuerung von Integrationen und Schnittstellen zu Kundensystemen, unter anderem ERP, WMS und TMS
Planung und Begleitung von Rollouts: Installation, Konfiguration, Inbetriebnahme, Test und Abnahme, inklusive Koordination von Montagedienstleistern und Vorbereitung der Einsätze vor Ort
Management von Risiken, Issues und Änderungen sowie deren Auswirkungen auf Zeitplan und Kundenvereinbarungen
Erwartungsmanagement beim Kunden und Unterstützung der Kollegen aus dem Vertrieb bei technischen Fragen
Saubere Projektdokumentation und geordnete Übergabe an den Betrieb, unter Beachtung der ISO-9001- und ISO-27001-Vorgaben
Rückspiegelung von Erfahrungen aus der Umsetzung an Produkt und Technik, damit die Lösungen weiter skalieren

Ihr Profil

Das sollten Sie mitbringen

Rund 5–10 Jahre Erfahrung im technischen Projektmanagement, in Technical Delivery, Solution Engineering oder Systemintegration
Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit komplexen technischen Kundenimplementierungen von der Anforderung bis zur Abnahme
Erfahrung in Umgebungen, in denen Hardware, Software, Konnektivität und Daten zusammenkommen, etwa IoT, Sensorik, Telematik, RFID, OT oder Intralogistik-Automatisierung
Sicherheit im Umgang mit Integrationen, Schnittstellen und APIs
Erfahrung in der Steuerung interner Teams, Lieferanten und Partner ohne disziplinarische Führung
Hands-on-Mentalität: Sie steuern nicht nur aus dem Projektplan, sondern sind auch im Lager oder Verteilzentrum präsent
Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und verhandlungssicheres Englisch
Wohnsitz im Raum Frankfurt oder Bereitschaft zum Umzug

Das ist ein deutliches Plus

Domänenwissen aus der Supply Chain im FMCG- oder Handelsumfeld: Verteilzentren, Ladungsträger, Pooling, Transport
Erfahrung mit ERP-, WMS- oder TMS-Umgebungen
Erfahrung mit Requirements Engineering, technischer Validierung, Test und Abnahme sowie mit Root-Cause-Analysen

Sie müssen kein Funk- oder Signaltechnik-Experte sein. Wichtig ist, dass Sie die Technik so weit durchdringen, dass Sie die richtigen Fragen stellen, Abhängigkeiten erkennen und rechtzeitig die passenden Spezialisten einbinden.

Was geboten wird

Die erste Delivery-Rolle in einer neu aufgebauten Region, mit entsprechendem Gestaltungsspielraum
Großprojekte mit namhaften Kunden aus Handel und FMCG, die gerade vom Pilotstadium in den Rollout gehen
Ein Produkt, das messbaren Nutzen liefert, statt einer weiteren Softwarelizenz
Büro in Frankfurt mit 2–3 Präsenztagen pro Woche, flexibel abhängig von Kundenterminen
Firmenwagen (elektrisch) und ein marktgerechtes Gesamtpaket
Kurze Wege in eine internationale Organisation mit Sitz in den Niederlanden

About the Company

At Future Secure AI, we're building something genuinely new — and we're looking for people bold enough to build it with us. We work at the frontier of AI, tackling big, real-world problems for global enterprises across multiple industries, armed with state-of-the-art technology and a culture that prizes courage, rigor, and relentless curiosity. Our BRAVER values aren't just words on a wall — they describe the kind of people we are and the standard we hold ourselves to every day. Our leadership team is entrepreneurial, experienced, and accessible, with an open-door policy that means you'll never be just a number here. We invest seriously in your growth because we know our success depends on yours. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry, push into uncharted territory, and do work that genuinely matters, Future Secure AI is the place for you.
About the Role

The purpose of this role is to orchestrate delivery across multiple production line pods on one or more customer accounts, aligning dependencies, timelines and priorities to keep a sharedprogram on track. Acting as a Way of Working coach at scale, the Technical Program Manager drives consistent practices, surfaces cross-use case risks, and removes systemic impediments so milestone commitments are met across every use case. 
Key Responsibilities

 You will be responsible for specific tasks and outcomes, including but not limited to: 
Planning & Release Management

Own the Cross-Use Case Release Plan for the production line(s): one living plan, updated weekly, with each use case's Design Review, Build, UAT and go-live and all dependencies on a single timeline. 
Sequence releases across a multi-quarter horizon spanning every use case on the account, including those not yet scoped, through to Hypercare. 

Delivery Accountability, RAID & Escalation

Own the production line-wide RAID picture, maintaining the risk register and Dependency Log across every active use case and driving resolution to closure. 

Be the point of contact for use case team challenges, receive escalations from Build Leads and Engagement Leads, and escalate to the APAC Delivery Leader where required. 

Dependency & Capacity Management

Spot where use cases compete for the same resource, platform support, customer attention or milestone; coach pods to resolve, and escalate unresolved conflicts to the Engagement Lead and Build Lead with impact and a priority recommendation. 

Own Capacity Mapping: a live view of who is allocated where and at what percentage across every use case, flagging over-allocation before a pod misses a commitment, with the Resource Manager and Operations Lead. 

Quality, Metrics & Reporting

Monitor Jira quality metrics per use case (defect rate, UAT pass rate, test coverage, production incidents), raising issues early when AI Co-Worker quality may be at risk. 

Produce one consistent read on account delivery health (milestones, dependencies, capacity, quality) for the Build Lead, Engagement Lead and AI Engineering Lead. 

Ceremonies, Coaching & Way of Working

Own the cross-use case ceremony set (weekly Scrum of Scrums, Sprint Health Reviews, Cross-Use Case Retrospectives with the Build Lead, and the Monthly Portfolio Review), observing pod ceremonies on rotation to coach. 

Foster the FSAI Way of Working, delivery standards, Jira hygiene and a solution-first mindset across pods, carrying what works in one pod across to the others. 

Authority, Tools & Environments

Hold named build-RACI accountability (Accountable for Build Readiness, Responsible for Platform Deployment Coordination) and own prioritization and sequencing when use cases compete. 

Own the subscription's artefacts (Release Plan, Capacity Map, Quality Scorecard, Dependency Log, Portfolio Hypercare Report), set up Jira and pod access, and coordinate UAT environments and the cross-use case go-live checklist. 

Relationships

Internal: Manage up and out to delivery leadership, Engagement Leads and Executive Directors; hold a trusted partnership with the Engagement Lead and flag resourcing risk early enough to act with the customer. 

External: Represent delivery health to customer sponsors and stakeholders, keeping the relationship focused on the account. 

  Key Requirements:

Demonstrated experience coordinating delivery across multiple concurrent Agile teams, ideally in a scaled or program environment 
Strong Agile delivery background (Scrum Master, RTE or Delivery Lead) with a record of coaching teams to predictable velocity 

Proven ability to own release planning, cross-team dependency management and portfolio capacity planning 

Able to hold accountability and influence without direct line authority, across peers, leads and executives 

Confident managing up and out to senior stakeholders, sponsors and program governance 

Advanced user of Jira and Confluence, with strong reporting and delivery-tooling hygiene 

A systems thinker who operates one level up, spotting cross-use case patterns before they surprise the account; AI, software or technology delivery experience preferred

An initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team

Securing Your Data

new_jobs.description:
About Marinhealth

Are you looking for a place where you are empowered to bring innovation to reality? Join MarinHealth, an integrated, independent healthcare system with deep roots throughout the North Bay. With a world-class physician and clinical team, an affiliation with UCSF Health, an ever-expanding network of clinics, and a new state-of-the-art hospital, MarinHealth is growing quickly. MarinHealth comprises MarinHealth Medical Center, a 327-bed hospital in Greenbrae, and 55 primary care and specialty clinics in Marin, Sonoma, and Napa Counties. We attract healthcare’s most talented trailblazers who appreciate having the best of both worlds: the pioneering medicine of an academic medical center combined with an independent hospital's personalized, caring touch.

MarinHealth is already realizing the benefits of impressive growth and has consistently earned high praise and accolades, including being Named One of the Top 250 Hospitals Nationwide by Healthgrades, receiving a 5-star Ranking for Overall Hospital Quality from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, and being named the Best Hospital in San Francisco/Marin by Bay Area Parent, among others.

Company

Prima Medical Foundation dba MarinHealth Medical Network

Work Shift

Day Shift (United States of America)

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Job Description Summary

The Population Health Program Manager guides and manages population health initiatives across MHMN ambulatory care practices to improve quality outcomes, close care gaps, optimize value-based care performance, and enhance patient access. This role serves as a part of the clinical quality leadership team and collaborates with clinical operations, physicians and APPs, care teams, payor partners, UCSF population health teams, MarinHealth Medical Center partners, and population health programs to lead initiatives ensuring patients receive timely, evidence-based care while meeting organizational and contractual quality goals.

Under the direction of the Director of Ambulatory Quality, and guidance of the Medical Director of quality and Ambulatory operational leadership team, the Population Health Program Manager contributes to the development and execution of strategies to improve preventive care, chronic disease management, risk adjustment performance, clinical outcomes for managed care patients, care coordination, and patient engagement. The position also plays a key role in training ambulatory staff and leaders, driving operational workflows, and integrating access management strategies that support quality, patient experience, and financial performance. The position helps to support the development and implementation of performance improvement plans and provide education to operational teams. The program manager would work with payers, UCSF population health, MarinHealth quality teams to develop relevant data analytics tools, dashboards for measurement of performance, and playbooks for implementing care redesign.

Pay Range

Job Requirements, Prerequisites and Essential Functions:

$57.69 - $72.11 - $86.53

Essential Functions And Responsibilities

Population Health & Care Gap Management

Lead organization-wide efforts to identify, prioritize, and close care gaps across preventive, chronic disease, and wellness measures.
Develop and implement workflows that improve performance on HEDIS, MIPs, CMS Star Ratings, quality metrics and incentives, and value-based care programs.
Monitor care gap performance through dashboards and analytics tools.
Partner with clinical staff members (including MDs, APPs, RNs, staff), clinic leaders, and care teams to improve outcomes such as for:
Diabetes management
Hypertension control
Cancer screenings
Immunizations
Annual wellness visits
Depression screening
Chronic disease management programs
HCC Coding, clinical documentation improvement

Conduct root-cause analyses of performance opportunities and develop action plans for improvement.
Develop action plans using PDSA and work to implement and educate clinical teams.
Work with clinicians to provide care management support for managed populations.
Lead outreach initiatives targeting high-risk, managed care/capitated, and underserved patient populations.
Work with teams to establish reports, standard dashboards to track and trend performance and action plans.

Payor Partnership Management

May serve as the operational lead for population health initiatives involving commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, and risk-based payor contracts.
Build collaborative relationships with payor partners to align quality improvement strategies and performance expectations.
Participate in regular joint operating reviews with health plans.
Analyze quality scorecards and incentive opportunities across multiple payor contracts.
Coordinate implementation of payor-sponsored care gap programs and member outreach campaigns.
Ensure clinic teams understand payer-specific quality measures and reporting requirements.
Monitor and communicate performance related to shared savings, quality incentives, and value-based reimbursement programs.

Access Management & Ambulatory Operations

Partner with operational leaders to improve patient access and reduce barriers to care as it related to quality measures.
Develop strategies to improve:
Preventive care scheduling
Follow-up appointment completion
Care coordination access
Referral management
Annual wellness visit completion

Collaborate with scheduling teams to create outreach campaigns for patients with open care gaps.
Support implementation of access strategies that improve continuity of care and appointment utilization.
Monitor no-show rates, cancellation trends, and scheduling effectiveness.
Recommend operational changes that support both quality outcomes and access performance.

Education, Training & Change Management

Design and deliver population health education programs for providers, leaders, care teams, referral coordinators, and scheduling staff.
Train MHMN ambulatory teams on:
Care gap closure workflows
Quality measures and benchmarks
Value-based care principles
Population health tools and dashboards
Risk adjustment documentation
Access optimization strategies

Develop standard work and educational materials to support sustainable performance improvement.
Coach clinic leadership teams on population health performance management.
Facilitate ongoing competency development related to quality and access initiatives.
Utilize project management and performance improvement skills with focus on care management goals.

Data Analytics & Performance Improvement

Analyze population health, quality, utilization, and access data to identify opportunities for improvement.
Create actionable reports and executive-level summaries.
Facilitate performance improvement projects using Lean, PDSA, DMAIC, or other improvement methodologies.
Support established key performance indicators (KPIs) and monitor progress toward organizational goals.
Present findings and recommendations to operational and physician leadership.
Support strategic planning related to value-based care and population health initiatives.

Leadership & Collaboration

Collaborate closely with providers, medical directors, clinic directors, care managers, referral teams, quality departments, and executive leadership.
Foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Lead multidisciplinary workgroups focused on quality, access, and patient outcomes.
Represent ambulatory operations in organizational population health committees and payor meetings.

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Public Health, Business Administration, or related field required.
Master's degree (MPH, MHA, MBA, MSN, or related field) preferred.

License & Certifications

N/A

Experience

Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in ambulatory healthcare operations, population health, care management, quality improvement, or value-based care.
Experience working directly with multiple health plan partners and quality programs.
Experience leading operational or clinical improvement initiatives.
Experience analyzing healthcare data and performance metrics.

Preferred Experience

Experience with:
Accountable Care Organizations (ACO)
Care management
Quality improvement standards, best practices
Medicare Advantage
Risk-based contracts
Shared savings programs
Primary Care and Specialty Care operations
Access management initiatives

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strong understanding of population health management principles.
Knowledge of HEDIS, Star Ratings, CMS quality measures, and value-based reimbursement models.
Understanding of ambulatory clinic operations and patient access workflows.
Advanced analytical and data interpretation skills.
Strong project management and change management capabilities.
Ability to influence clinical and operational leaders without direct authority.
Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
Proficiency with electronic health records, registries, reporting tools, and population health platforms.

Key Performance Indicators

The Population Health Manager is accountable for measurable improvement in:

Care gap closure rates
Annual wellness visit completion
HEDIS and Star measure performance
Chronic disease outcome metrics
Risk adjustment accuracy and completion
Patient access metrics
Third next available appointment
Referral completion rates

Value-based reimbursement performance

About Us

Solflare is one of the fastest-growing crypto wallets in the world. With around 3.5 million monthly active users and over $20 billion in digital assets secured through our platform, we’re building a powerful gateway to Web3. Founded in 2021, Solflare now has a team of nearly 100 people, with offices in Zagreb, Belgrade, and Novi Sad, plus remote teams across the globe. Our vision is simple but bold: a world where everyone uses a Web3 wallet and has full control over their assets – achieving true financial independence.

Our culture

At Solflare, we’re on a mission to empower people to truly own and thrive – starting with our own team. We take on bold challenges with curiosity, grit, and a deep sense of accountability. Here, progress means learning fast, solving smart, and showing up for each other without ego. You’ll join a team where we question the status quo, celebrate shared wins, and never settle for “just good enough.” If you’re excited by growth – yours, ours, and society’s – you’ll feel right at home.

Job Description

The role

As a Senior Data Analyst at Solflare, you’ll dive deep into data to uncover insights and trends that help us make better decisions about our product and its growth. You’ll work closely with product managers, engineers, and other teams to turn complex, raw data into clear and actionable insights. Your work will directly influence important decisions, from improving existing product features and identifying opportunities for new ones to shaping our market expansion strategy.

What makes analytics at Solflare particularly interesting is the depth and variety of data available to us. Since blockchain data is public, we can analyze user behavior at the individual transaction level across the wider Solana ecosystem, not just within Solflare. This means that a user’s journey does not necessarily start when they first open or create a Solflare wallet. Blockchain data allows us to understand parts of their activity before they become a Solflare user, including which wallets and protocols they used, how they transacted, where their assets moved, and how their behavior changed after adopting Solflare.

Analyzing the blockchain gives us the opportunity to answer questions that traditional product analytics often cannot. We can track market shares, explore how users interact with competing companies, where assets are moving, and which products or behaviors are gaining traction across the ecosystem.

By combining this on-chain information with our off-chain product data, such as app activity, event tracking, and internal user data, we get a uniquely rich view of the full user journey. You might investigate what users do on-chain after using Solflare, identify behavioral patterns connected to retention or churn, or uncover opportunities for new products, features, and integrations.

If you’re excited by complex data, curious about user behavior, and ready to work in a role where your insights can directly shape product strategy and company growth, we’d love to hear from you.

Core Responsibilities

Data collection: You’ll gather data from a variety of sources (databases, APIs, spreadsheets) and ensure it’s accurate, complete, and relevant to the business questions at hand.
Data preparation: Actively contributing to our data pipeline, building and maintaining the transformation logic that turns raw data into analysis-ready datasets.
Exploratory analysis: Use statistical techniques and data visualization to uncover trends, patterns, and correlations in the data. This will help guide the team in making data-driven decisions.
Reporting & visualization: You’ll create clear and insightful dashboards, reports, and charts, making it easy for stakeholders to understand the findings and take action.
Collaboration with teams: Work alongside product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to define key metrics and provide data-driven recommendations that shape the product roadmap.
Data integrity: Ensure that the data is secure, well-documented, and accessible to those who need it most.

Qualifications

Requirements:

Experience: 5+ years of experience in data analysis or engineering involving large amounts of different types of data
Statistical analysis: Experience with hypothesis testing, A/B testing, and other statistical methods.
Programming & data manipulation: Proficiency in at least one programming language for data cleaning, transformation, and analysis.
SQL: Strong skills in writing and optimizing SQL queries to extract and aggregate data from databases.
Data visualization tools: Experience with business intelligence tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar.
AI-assisted development: Experience integrating AI tools (e.g. Claude Code) into your engineering workflow for faster iteration and higher-quality output
Spreadsheets: Solid experience using Excel or Google Sheets for quick analysis and pivot tables.
ETL & data workflow: Basic understanding of ETL processes and tools to move data from different sources into a usable format.

Nice To Have

Fintech/banking/insurance industry experience
Experience with processing blockchain data (e.g. using data from Dune, Solscan, etc.).

Additional Information

Personality Traits We Value

Problem-solvers: You see roadblocks as opportunities and don’t wait around for someone else to fix things.
Self-starters: You take initiative, follow through, and deliver with pride – no excuses, no shortcuts.
Team players: You thrive in a “we, not me” culture, lifting others up while sharing the load.
Adaptable minds: You embrace change, question how things are done, and constantly look for better ways.
Ownership mindset: You own your work end-to-end, communicate openly, and learn from every challenge.

Why Solflare?

Make an impact: Your work will directly shape how people interact with and understand crypto wallets, empowering users around the globe.
Work with the best: Collaborate with a talented, driven team across design, engineering, and product to build innovative, user-first experiences.
Flexibility: Remote or office – up to you. Enjoy a flexible work environment based on trust that supports your well-being and fosters creativity, as well as flexible work time – work when you are most productive, with no micromanagement.
Perks & benefits: individual education budget, cool team buildings, private health insurance, to name a few.
Learn about Crypto: No crypto experience? No problem! You’ll be part of a team that will teach you the ropes and help you grow into an expert.

Join us at Solflare
and be part of something bigger than yourself. We’re not just reacting to trends; we’re building the future. If you’re ready to push boundaries, challenge assumptions, and make an impact, we want to hear from you.

Apply now and help us shape the future of decentralized finance.

new_jobs.description:
Position Overview

Our client is looking for a strategic Senior Business Analyst focused on Operational Excellence, responsible for the overall health and ongoing improvement of their Business Support System (BSS) operations. This person will act as the connective link between business stakeholders and technical teams to drive operational excellence. Core duties include spotting operational bottlenecks, leading process-improvement efforts, and making sure BSS systems and workflows (Front End, Order Management, and Billing) stay aligned with shifting business priorities and customer requirements.

Process Improvement & Continuous Optimization

Champion Operational Excellence:
Proactively surface systemic bottlenecks and inefficiencies that affect delivery quality.
Functional Analysis:
Conduct root-cause analysis on processes affecting the business, emphasizing process gaps and business-logic issues over code-level troubleshooting.
Lead Improvement Efforts:
Collaborate across teams to design and drive continuous-improvement projects that simplify workflows, cut down manual work (including through AI adoption), and shorten cycle times.
Data-Driven Insight:
Establish, monitor, and report on key operational metrics (KPIs) to spot trends, guide process improvements, and build the case for system investments.

Stakeholder Management & Liaison

Connect the Dots:
Serve as the main point of contact linking Business owners, Product Management, Engineering, and Operations, keeping everyone aligned on project goals and system implications.
Own Requirements:
Manage and prioritize the roadmap for operational and system enhancements/fixes based on business impact, revenue potential, and the customer/employee experience.
Drive Change Management:
Lead documentation of new processes, build training materials, and support adoption of new features or workflows.
Support Post-Incident Reviews:
Take part in business-focused post-mortems and root-cause analyses to capture lessons learned and inform preventive process changes.

Work Environment

Our client's BSS Operations department consists of roughly 100 team members based in Japan and India. Teams are generally organized around core BSS workflows (Front End, Order Management, Billing) as well as key functional areas such as change management, customer support, and incident management.

The team is highly diverse — a mix of new graduates and mid-career hires from over 10 nationalities, with mid-career staff bringing backgrounds from a wide variety of industries. Communication with business stakeholders happens in both Japanese and English, while interactions with technical teams are conducted mainly in English.

Required Qualifications

Business Analysis:
Demonstrated experience gathering business requirements, mapping processes, and doing functional design within an agile, enterprise environment.
Analytical Ability:
Track record of analyzing complex data to spot trends, diagnose process breakdowns, and inform decisions, along with hands-on experience creating, managing, and reporting on KPIs.
Process Knowledge:
5+ years driving operational process improvement initiatives, plus familiarity with the Software Development Life Cycle.
Communication Skills:
Strong stakeholder management ability, with skill translating technical issues for business audiences and vice versa.
Tools & Methods:
Proven project management background; hands-on proficiency with business/data analysis tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL, SAP) and data visualization; experience with ITSM tools and methods (ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence).
Professional Fit:
Experience working with Japanese clients, solid organizational skills, and a strong focus on quality and compliance.
Education:
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Language
: Business-level Japanese and English required.

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years working in Telecom BSS, Order Management, or billing processes, with strong knowledge of the full order lifecycle.
Experience with ITSM tools/methods such as ServiceNow or Jira.

À propos du poste

Dans le cadre d’un programme international de transformation digitale, HCLTech recherche un(e) Senior Business Analyst spécialisé(e) dans les Digital Commercial & Dealer Operations
.
Ce rôle se situe à l’intersection des opérations commerciales, du Business Analysis et des systèmes IT
. Vous travaillerez directement avec les équipes métier, commerciales, digitales et techniques afin d’analyser les processus existants, recueillir les besoins et les traduire en solutions fonctionnelles et technologiques adaptées.

Le périmètre couvre notamment les ventes, réseaux de distribution et de concessionnaires, retail operations, Order-to-Cash, après-vente, atelier/maintenance, gestion des garanties ainsi que les parcours digitaux et e-commerce
.

Vos principales responsabilités

Vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

Recueillir, analyser et challenger les besoins des équipes métier.
Traduire les besoins opérationnels en exigences fonctionnelles et techniques
pour les équipes IT.
Cartographier et optimiser les processus commerciaux end-to-end, notamment Lead-to-Order et Order-to-Cash
.
Intervenir sur les processus liés aux ventes, aux réseaux de distribution/dealers, au retail, à l’après-vente, aux ateliers, à la maintenance et à la gestion des garanties.
Analyser les systèmes existants et identifier les impacts fonctionnels et techniques des évolutions demandées.
Contribuer à la conception fonctionnelle des solutions et à la définition des flux entre les différentes plateformes.
Travailler avec les équipes IT, Architecture, Product et Software Engineering
afin de définir et valider les solutions.
Participer aux problématiques d’intégration entre les systèmes dealers/distributeurs et les plateformes centrales.
Définir et valider les règles métier liées aux plateformes commerciales.
Contribuer aux évolutions des solutions CRM, DMS, CPQ, Order-to-Cash
et autres plateformes commerciales et digitales.
Identifier des opportunités de simplification, d’automatisation et de digitalisation des processus.
Participer à la transformation des parcours clients, des ventes et de l’après-vente.
Animer des ateliers avec les équipes métier et techniques.
Représenter les besoins du marché français dans un environnement international.

Expertise fonctionnelle et technique

La dimension IT est essentielle pour ce poste.
Nous recherchons un profil disposant d’une expérience significative de Business Analysis dans des environnements IT complexes
, capable de comprendre aussi bien les besoins opérationnels que leur traduction dans les systèmes et applications.

Une expérience sur plusieurs des environnements suivants est particulièrement recherchée :

CRM, notamment Salesforce, SAP CRM ou solutions équivalentes
;
SAP Sales & Distribution
ou solutions commerciales ERP similaires ;
Dealer Management Systems – DMS
;
CPQ – Configure, Price, Quote
;
solutions et processus Order-to-Cash
;
plateformes e-commerce ou Digital Experience ;
systèmes liés à l’après-vente, aux ateliers, à la maintenance ou aux garanties.
Vous devrez également être à l’aise avec :
les architectures fonctionnelles ;
les flux et interfaces entre différentes applications ;
les intégrations entre systèmes dealers et plateformes centrales ;
les dépendances entre CRM, DMS, ERP et autres solutions commerciales ;
la formalisation des requirements, business rules et spécifications fonctionnelles.
Il ne s’agit pas d’un poste de développement, mais vous devez disposer d’un niveau de compréhension technique suffisant pour challenger les solutions, travailler efficacement avec les architectes et les équipes IT et comprendre les impacts système des besoins métier
.

Profil recherché

Vous disposez idéalement de :

8 ans d’expérience minimum
en Business Analysis, opérations commerciales, transformation digitale ou environnement comparable ;
une expérience confirmée comme Senior Business Analyst, Functional Business Analyst, Business Architect, Functional Consultant ou SME
;
une solide expérience sur des projets impliquant à la fois des équipes métier et IT ;
une excellente compréhension des processus commerciaux end-to-end ;
une expérience des dealer/distribution operations
ou de réseaux de concessionnaires/distributeurs ;
une bonne compréhension des processus sales, retail, Order-to-Cash, after-sales, workshop/maintenance et warranty management
;
une expérience concrète avec des plateformes CRM et commerciales ;
la capacité à transformer des besoins métier en exigences fonctionnelles et techniques ;
une expérience de programmes de transformation digitale ou commerciale à grande échelle.
Une expérience dans les secteurs automobile, véhicules commerciaux, poids lourds, équipements industriels ou environnements comparables
sera particulièrement appréciée.

Atouts supplémentaires

Une expérience avec les plateformes e-commerce, les parcours clients digitaux ou les outils de reporting et analytics tels que Power BI, Tableau ou SAP Analytics Cloud
constitue un plus.

Langues

Un français courant, niveau C1 minimum
, est indispensable afin d’animer des réunions et ateliers avec les équipes locales.
Un anglais professionnel
est également requis pour collaborer quotidiennement avec les équipes internationales.

Pourquoi rejoindre HCLTech ?

Vous rejoindrez un programme de transformation international et interviendrez sur des sujets stratégiques mêlant business, digital et technologie
.
Ce rôle offre une forte exposition aux équipes métier et IT et permet de contribuer directement à la transformation des processus commerciaux, des réseaux de distribution et de l’expérience client.

About The Job

This role leads the execution of the Labs technology portfolio that powers Keysight’s RF product roadmap—spanning MMICs, SiPs, and subsystems. You will run a single PLC across Labs technologies (NCI, NSI, Subsystems) from CON to SHP, giving leadership a clear view of investment, schedule, dependencies, and realized ROI into NPIs. You’ll align deliverables with Centers of Excellence (CoEs) and Solutions Groups, orchestrate fab priority with the Labs Materials Planner (in concert with PICO and PMTC), and drive resourcing tradeoffs with other TPMs and Technology Managers. You’ll partner with product and research leaders to capture future requirements, compare proposals to next‑best commercial alternatives, make data‑driven investment recommendations, and market Labs parts for maximal reuse and ROI across multiple product lines.

About The Team

You will join the Signal Conditioning and Subsystems
section in Keysight Labs. The team builds analog and mm‑wave front ends (ICs + modules)
for VNA platforms and frequency-domain applications, collaborating closely with CoEs and Industry Solutions Groups.

Responsibilities

Portfolio & PLC Governance (CON → SHP)

Run a single PLC across Labs technologies (NCI, NSI, Subsystems) that feed RF Instrument NPIs; maintain a unified, auditable view of scope, cost, schedule, risk, and benefits.
Define and track gate criteria and closure plans; ensure cross‑functional readiness for each PLC gate.
Maintain a concise executive dashboard highlighting status, deltas, critical risks, dependencies, and ROI realization.

Planning & Execution

Run regular project meetings (with IC, SIP and subsystem attendees together) and track progress from all contributors, raising and resolving any technical/non-technical issue appropriately
Align with CoEs on NCI/NSI/Subsystem deliverables (scope, schedule, acceptance criteria) tied to NPI milestones.
Sequence/coordinate fab runs and builds with the Labs Materials Planner; ensure end‑to‑end priority alignment with PICO and PMTC.
Manage integration plans for MMICs, SiPs, and subsystems into VNA architectures, including validation and qualification dependencies.

Resourcing, Risk & Dependency Management

Partner with Labs TPMs and Technology Managers to broker staffing tradeoffs and resolve bottlenecks.
Drive proactive risk identification/mitigation (supply, process, yield, packaging, test throughput, firmware dependencies).
Maintain what‑if scenarios for critical paths and long‑lead items (masks, substrates, specialized materials, fixtures).

Requirements & Roadmapping

Meet regularly with CoE and IST PMs/planners: capture future requirements (performance, cost, reliability, manufacturability) for ICs, SiPs, subsystems; translate into capability roadmaps.
Partner with design leads and architects to balance performance vs. cost vs. schedule; validate feasibility against fab and assembly/test constraints.

Stakeholder Communication

Provide regular program updates to Labs senior management, with sharp narratives and decision asks.
Keep customer/partner divisions synchronized on progress and risks.

Technical Context (RF/uW/mmW Focus)

Manage building blocks typical of RF front ends and frequency‑domain chains (e.g., mixers, LNAs/PAs, T/R modules, couplers/attenuators/switches, LO distribution, frequency extenders, calibration and metrology modules, multi‑chip SiPs, and integrated subsystems).
Ensure test strategies and DVT/qualification align with RF performance targets, including stability, linearity, noise, dynamic range, and calibration integrity.

What Success Looks Like (Examples of KPIs)

Predictable execution: forecast accuracy on schedule/cost; green trend on risk burndown.
Cycle‑time reduction for fab/build/test loops; improved yield/first‑pass success on critical MMICs/SiPs.
Stakeholder satisfaction: positive feedback from CoEs, Solutions Groups, and external customers (where applicable).

Qualifications

Core Qualifications

B.S./M.S./Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or related field with 5–10+ years of applicable experience in analog/mm‑wave ICs, SiPs, and related packaging/subsystem technologies.
1–5+ years in technical project/program management for new technologies and NPIs (or Team Lead roles with equivalent scope).
Strong communicator with a track record of instilling customer confidence and aligning diverse stakeholders.
Broad knowledge of electronic systems, especially high‑frequency analog/RF/mmWave and relevant subsystems.
General understanding of semiconductor foundry operations, including Keysight HFTC and external partners.
Demonstrated ability to make decisions, take initiative, drive to results, and collaborate in fast‑paced environments.

Desired Qualifications

Experience orchestrating fab priorities, materials planning, and E2E build/test flows for MMICs/SiPs/subsystems.
Familiarity with PLC gating, NPI governance, and tools such as Jira/Confluence, MS Project/Smartsheet, Power BI/Excel.
Background working with CoEs/Solutions Groups and external customers on requirements and productization.
Understanding of reliability/qualification considerations for RF/mmWave components and modules.
